instruction: A candid wide-shot documentary photograph captures an indoor motion capture studio featuring a red carpeted floor, white walls, and wall-mounted cameras. On the left side of the frame, the man in the black polo shirt and blue shorts (R1) stands upright, facing toward the right. On the right, the woman in the white t-shirt and blue jeans (R2) steps forward dynamically, facing left, and extends her left arm to touch the man's (R1) right upper arm. The background shows white walls with radiators and partition panels. The entire scene is evenly illuminated by bright, neutral overhead lighting, casting soft shadows on the red carpet.
elements: R2 actively extends her left arm to touch R1's right upper arm
R1 receives the arm touch rather than initiating it
R2 steps forward dynamically toward R1 during the contact
R1 stands upright while being touched by R2
